{{Quote|It's like I'm seasick or something. You know how I got floating on the waves on Camus IV, pal, that time we tried to take a little vacation?|Han Solo, to Chewbacca|<ref name="Journal" />}}
'''Camus IV''' was the fourth [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Journal" /> in the [[Camus system/Legends|Camus system]]<ref name="Atlas" /> of the [[Illisurevimurasi sector/Legends|Illisurevimurasi sector]], located within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Trans-Hydian" /> Sometime prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars Journal: Hero for Hire]]'' is set immediately following [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] [[Rescue of Han Solo/Legends|liberation]] from [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], as depicted in the film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]. The preceding film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], covers Solo's [[Time/Legends|time]] from the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] to his [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbon-freezing]], thus placing his trip to Camus IV sometime prior.</ref> the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] once vacationed on Camus IV, but Solo became seasick while floating among the planet's [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Water/Legends|waves]].<ref name="Journal" />

==Behind the scenes==
Camus IV was created for the [[1998]] young-readers story ''[[Star Wars Journal: Hero for Hire]]'', written by [[Donna Tauscher]].<ref name="Journal" />

The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Camus [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square Q-4.<ref name="Atlas" />
